Sign Up & Fund Your Wallet

Create your free account in under 5 minutes. Complete FICA verification and fund your wallet via EFT or instant bank payment — no minimums on your wallet.

⏱ Takes less than 5 minutes
02

Choose Your Investment

Browse live investment pools. Each listing shows real-time pool progress, expected returns, term length, and full product details. Select the product that fits your goals.

📊 Real-time pool tracking
03

We Manage Everything

Once invested, our partners (Beefcor, The Solar Experts, MoolaLend, OnFleet) professionally manage the underlying assets. You track progress on your dashboard.

Receive Your Payout

At maturity, choose to reinvest, switch products, take a partial payout, or withdraw everything to your bank account. Full control, your way.
